_what: Where the show-rules reader (src/local_account/show_rules.rs) finds each DATA file it reads: name -> [tool folder, file inside it] in the account's installed Workshop (src/tool_runs/tools/installed_data.rs). The DATA has one owner, the Workshop; the engine carries no copy, and an account whose Workshop does not carry a file reads no show rules (unavailable source), never a guessed default.
